_doc: Outro text (src/scene/outro.py). One line = one text, or [text, relative size]. Blank line = space. Validated by Ilyas on 22 Nov 2026, English.
lignes: The village was evacuated before the collapse,
thanks to those who modelled the risk,
the teams who evacuated the valley on the ground,
and the cooperation of its residents.
A thought for the 64-year-old sheep farmer who lost his life.
3D modelling, rendering and sound: Ilyas Hammouti, Maxime Lescarret and Justin Mocogni
Journées Mouvements de Terrain, Laboratoire de Géographie Physique (CNRS)
Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne, Université Paris Cité, Université Paris-Est Créteil
Trees: EZ-Tree (D. Greenheck, MIT); textures: Poly Haven, texturecan (CC0)
